scripts.build: tsc && vite build --mode preprod && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('./dist', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/keys')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/keys', './dist/keys', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/zkir')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/zkir', './dist/zkir', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:preview: tsc && vite build --mode preview && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('./dist', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/keys')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/keys', './dist/keys', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/zkir')) fs.cpSync('../contract/src/managed/dice/zkir', './dist/zkir', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
